results.question: How much did the Barr Foundation grant SSL in 2020-21, and what was the stated purpose?
results.output: The Sustainable Solutions Lab (SSL) received $20,000 from the Barr Foundation [1]. The purpose of the grant was "to deepen our commitment to centering Racial Justice in our work and support our efforts to be an anti-racist research institute at UMB" [1].

SLIDE 31 — BARR FOUNDATION AWARDS ADDITIONAL FUNDS TO SUPPORT FACULTY OF COLOR
================================================================================
SSL received $20,000 from the Barr Foundation to deepen our commitment to
centering Racial Justice in our work and support our efforts to be an anti-racist
research institute at UMB. As part of this effort, SSL provided Summer
Anti-Racism Research Funding to seven projects led by affiliated faculty with
grants of up to $2,500 for climate justice research that do at least one of
the following:
- Identify disproportionate impacts of climate change on different racial groups
- Propose anti-racist policy changes to address climate disparities
- Center BIPOC voices in the research efforts
================================================================================
